data_fields.name: emitter_position
data_fields.donor_constant: event tile x,y (+0.5); (0,0) means no position

data_fields.name: map_music_track
data_fields.donor_constant: music= per map file, 11 distinct values

data_fields.name: hit_voice_key
data_fields.donor_constant: entity_hit_<clip id>, one voice per name

best_idea: Pause a looping ambience when the listener is beyond its radius and resume it inside, and key each hit voice by the clip name so one clip cannot pile up.
decision_why: Keep the radius pause and the named-clip voice key for zone loops and hit cues; fix the (0,0) no-position sentinel, the failed-start path and add real priority; reject the flat no-pan distance-only model for the over-the-shoulder camera.
acceptance: Walk 15 tiles away from a river loop and it goes quiet and returns when you come back; a second hit with the same clip restarts that clip and does not stack a second copy (client unit test of CueMixer.tick and play, no server involved).
